title: Clifford Chance PSC - Working Effectively at Clifford Chance (with Martin Chapman)
quote: Martin delivered the session very well and is a very enthusiastic speaker. He did well to keep everyone engaged (with a topic which, on the face of it, is not overly exciting to trainees!). The session was good and got us thinking critically about methods of day-to-day working which we usually take for granted/do subconsciously, which in some cases are bad habit. Martin had an appreciation that in the working context (heat of the moment) things are not as easy as talking them through, but gave us practical pointers that we can build upon and practice as juniors.
author: Lewis W
subject: Personal Efficiency
